title: TUI edit pane: first Enter should not blank other fields; cycled fields should apply on one Enter
description:
Observed with the cb08a6e4 inline edit pane (landed 2026-09-22): Left/Right cycles Type/Status; the first Enter arms editing and makes the Title and Description rows render as empty buffer lines with a cursor (the shared edit buffer starts empty), so the pane looks like it wiped all other field values; a second Enter then commits through the operations layer. The values are never actually removed (the commit reloads from disk), but the intermediate state is confusing. Ask: while editing any field, render live values for rows other than the active one (buffer only for the active row); and for Type/Status (which are cycled, not typed) apply on the first Enter instead of needing arm+commit. Update r[tui-edit] SPEC text and e2e accordingly.

Agreed scope (manager+owner 2026-09-24): (1) render LIVE values for rows other than the active one while editing (display bug); (2) cycled Type/Status apply on the FIRST Enter (commit-and-stay), typed Title/Description keep arm-then-commit; (3) proper in-buffer editing for Title/Description: cursor movement (Left/Right/Home/End while editing), Delete, and multi-line Description (Enter inserts newline) - the current pane is append-only with flattened description; ADOPT ratatui-textarea 0.9.2 for Title/Description editing (version-compatible with the pinned split-core stack; spike the crossterm-key/render adapter first, wood fallback to a DIY in-buffer editor if the adapter fights the pane architecture); (4) update SPEC r[tui-edit] and unit/e2e tests.
